project_title: EduCentro OTEC - Platforma Educativa e Institucional
theme: Light mode default with dark mode toggle. Deep institutional slate navy background accents with warm ivory/slate surfaces and academic emerald primary accents.
archetype: ARCHETYPE 1 & 4 HYBRID: ACADEMIC AUTHORITY & MODERN PRECISION (Grounded Slate, Deep Emerald, Warm Sand & Electric Cobalt)

typography.font_family_heading: Plus Jakarta Sans, Cabinet Grotesk, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy_rules.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy_rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy_rules.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200
hierarchy_rules.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-normal leading-relaxed
hierarchy_rules.caption: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

ai_detection_badge.low_ai: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800
ai_detection_badge.medium_ai: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/50 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800
ai_detection_badge.high_ai: bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-950/50 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous Tailwind spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12 for dashboard containers and cards
layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 p-6

otp_login.description: Clean auth page with centered OTP 6-digit verification code input, resend timer, and instant email verification code state.

dashboard_analytics.description: Admin and teacher control panel with student access charts, active time monitoring, course progress bars, and CSV export capabilities.

ai_detector_panel.description: Claude AI percentage probability analyzer for student open-answer exam submissions with highlighted AI-generated sentences and reasoning breakdown.

modular_course_flow.description: Sequential module unlock workflow requiring student completion of asynchronous module N before unlocking module N+1.

live_classes.description: Teams and Google Meet session manager with live status indicators and 'Abrir clase' external launcher buttons.

diploma_and_qr.description: Official OTEC diploma viewer with rector and vice-rector signature PNG graphics, student Rut/DNI, verification QR code linking to public verification endpoint (/verificar-diploma/:code).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as per project setup.
Ensure all user-facing UI text is strictly in Spanish (Español).
Implement Sonner toast notifications (from src/components/ui/sonner) for user feedback.
Ensure header navigation has sticky positioning with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 and z-50.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all buttons, form fields, navigation items, metrics, and interactive elements.
Never use generic centered layouts globally; use asymmetrical bento grids for student/admin portals.
Include Claude AI probability bar for open-text evaluation reviews.
